arxiv-1803-04651.title: Compressive Sensing Based User Clustering for Downlink NOMA Systems with Decoding Power Z. Yang, W. Xu and M. Chen are with the National Mobile Communications Research Laboratory, Southeast University, Nanjing 210096, China (Email: {yangzhaohui, wxu, chenming}@seu.edu.cn). C. Pan is with the School
arxiv-1803-04651.creator: Zhaohui Yang, Cunhua Pan, Wei Xu, , and Ming Chen
arxiv-1803-04651.description: Abstract This letter investigates joint power control and user clustering for downlink non-orthogonal multiple access systems. Our aim is to minimize the total power consumption by taking into account not only the conventional transmission power but also the decoding power of the users. To solve this optimization problem, it is firstly transformed into an equivalent problem with tractable constraints.

arxiv-2201-01806.title: Revisiting Deep Subspace Alignment for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
arxiv-2201-01806.creator: Kowshik Thopalli, Jayaraman J Thiagarajan, Rushil Anirudh, and Pavan K Turaga
arxiv-2201-01806.description: Abstract Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) aims to transfer and adapt knowledge from a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain. Traditionally, subspace-based methods form an important class of solutions to this problem. Despite their mathematical elegance and tractability, these methods are often found to be ineffective at producing domain-invariant features with complex, real-world datasets.

arxiv-2210-16277.title: Robustness and Convergence Analysis of First-Order Distributed Optimization Algorithms over Subspace Constraints
arxiv-2210-16277.creator: Dennis J. Marquis, Dany Abou Jaoude, Mazen Farhood, and Craig A. Woolsey
arxiv-2210-16277.description: Abstract This paper extends algorithms that remove the fixed point bias of decentralized gradient descent to solve the more general problem of distributed optimization over subspace constraints. Leveraging the integral quadratic constraint framework, we analyze the performance of these generalized algorithms in terms of worst-case robustness and convergence rate.

arxiv-2212-10857.title: A Portal Dedicated to Higgs Bosons for Experts and the General Public
arxiv-2212-10857.description: Abstract As an educational aid and source for expert information, a web portal dedicated to Higgs boson research is presented. A database is created with more than 1000 relevant articles using CERN Document Server API and web scraping methods. The database is automatically updated when new results on the Higgs boson become available.

arxiv-2405-03796.title: Approximating a branch of solutions to the Navier–Stokes equations by reduced-order modeling
arxiv-2405-03796.creator: Maxim A. Olshanskii, Leo G. Rebholz
arxiv-2405-03796.description: Abstract This paper extends a low-rank tensor decomposition (LRTD) reduced order model (ROM) methodology to simulate viscous flows and in particular to predict a smooth branch of solutions for the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations. Additionally, it enhances the LRTD-ROM methodology by introducing a non-interpolatory variant, which demonstrates improved accuracy compared to the interpolatory method utilized in previous LRTD-ROM studies.

arxiv-2501-18326.title: Transductions of Graph Classes Admitting Product Structure
arxiv-2501-18326.creator: Petr Hliněný, Jan Jedelský
arxiv-2501-18326.description: Abstract In a quest to thoroughly understand the first-order transduction hierarchy of hereditary graph classes, some questions in particular stand out; such as, what properties hold for graph classes that are first-order transductions of planar graphs (and of similar classes)?

arxiv-2506-08346.title: SPBA: Utilizing Speech Large Language Model for Backdoor Attacks on Speech Classification Models
arxiv-2506-08346.creator: 1 st Wenhan Yao, 2 nd Fen Xiao, 3 rd Xiarun Chen, 4 th Jia Liu, 5 th YongQiang He, 6 th Weiping Wen
arxiv-2506-08346.description: Abstract Deep speech classification tasks, including keyword spotting and speaker verification, are vital in speech-based human-computer interaction. Recently, the security of these technologies has been revealed to be susceptible to backdoor attacks. Specifically, attackers use noisy disruption triggers and speech element triggers to produce poisoned speech samples that train models to become vulnerable.

arxiv-2602-06318.title: Disorder-induced symmetry breaking in moiré bands of marginally twisted bilayer MoS 2
arxiv-2602-06318.creator: Pablo Reséndiz-Vázquez, Christophe de Beule, Thi-Hai-Yen Vu, Kaijian Xing, Daniel McEwen, Daniel Bennett, Liangtao Peng, Héctor González-Herrero, Shaffique Adam, Mark T. Edmonds, Michael S. Fuhrer
arxiv-2602-06318.description: Abstract Twisted transition - metal dichalcogenides host highly tunable moiré potentials, flat bands, and correlated electronic phases, yet the role of disorder in shaping these emergent properties remains largely unresolved. Using scanning tunneling spectroscopy, we investigate the impact of electrostatic disorder on the electronic structure of marginally twisted ( θ ≈ 0.95 ∘ \theta\approx 0.95^{\circ} ) bilayer MoS 2 .

pmc-10514981.title: The association between material-psychological-behavioral framework of financial hardship and markers of inflammation: a cross-sectional study of the Midlife in the United States (MIDUS) Refresher cohort
pmc-10514981.creator: Agus Surachman, Reginald Tucker-Seeley, David M Almeida
pmc-10514981.description: BackgroundMeasures of financial hardship have been suggested to supplement traditional indicators of socioeconomic status (SES) to elucidate household economic well-being. This study formally tested the construct validity of financial hardship and examined its association with markers of inflammation.MethodsThis study utilized data from the Midlife Development in the United States Refresher Study (MIDUS-R; Age = 23-76, 53.7% female, 71% white).

pmc-10650610.title: 1,25-Dihydroxyvitamin D3 Provides Benefits in Vitiligo Based on Modulation of CD8+ T Cell Glycolysis and Function
pmc-10650610.creator: Yujia Wei, Tingmei Wang, Xiaoqi Nie, Zeqi Shi, Zhong Liu, Ying Zeng, Ronghua Pan, Ri Zhang, Yunhua Deng, Dong Li
pmc-10650610.description: Vitiligo is a common autoimmune skin disease caused by autoreactive CD8+ T cells. The diverse effects of 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D₃ [1,25(OH)₂D₃] on immune cell metabolism and proliferation have made it an interesting candidate as a supporting therapeutic option in various autoimmune diseases. This study aimed to elucidate the immunomodulatory effects of 1,25(OH)₂D₃ in vitiligo.

pmc-12577571.title: Comparison of the clinical usefulness of CXCL-8 and common clinical tumor markers for esophageal cancer diagnosis
pmc-12577571.creator: Pingxia Lu, Baowei Xu, Xinyu Zhang, Cuifeng Zheng, Xianqiang Chen, Junrong Zhang, Yingping Cao, Zhengyuan Huang
pmc-12577571.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to investigate serum CXC motif chemokine ligand 8 (CXCL-8) as a potential biomarker for diagnosing esophageal cancer (EC).MethodsPatients diagnosed with EC (n = 141) were enrolled at the Department of Thoracic Surgery, Fujian Medical University Union Hospital, from July through December 2023.

pmc-12691404.title: Challenges and Progress for Treatment of Malignant Peripheral Nerve Sheath Tumors in the Context of Recent Successes for Sarcoma Therapy
pmc-12691404.creator: John F Callaghan, Raymond R Mattingly, Carlos S Moreno
pmc-12691404.description: Simple SummaryMalignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors (MPNSTs) are rare soft tissue sarcomas commonly associated with genetic cancer predisposition neurofibromatosis type 1. These tumors are resistant to conventional chemotherapy and radiotherapy, leaving surgery as the only definitive treatment. Many drugs have been developed and investigated to improve the outlook for patients who develop MPNSTs, but outcomes have yet to significantly improve.

pmc-12808732.title: A comprehensive dataset of riverine levee overtopping events for advancing risk assessment
pmc-12808732.creator: Stefan Flynn, Farshid Vahedifard, David Schaaf
pmc-12808732.description: Earthen levees are the primary flood protection infrastructure worldwide, with overtopping recognized as the most prevalent mode of their failure. Despite its significance, detailed field data on overtopping events are often limited and fragmented. Here we present the Levee Loading and Incident Dataset - Overtopping (LLID-OT) version 1.0, a curated dataset of 487 overtopping events in U.S.

pmc-12836939.title: Host immunogenetics and EBV detection in cancer: the CTLA-4 rs231775 signal in a multi-cancer case–control cohort
pmc-12836939.creator: Noor Kadhim Abed, Abolfazl Bayrami, Saber Zahri
pmc-12836939.description: BackgroundPersistent oncogenic viruses are common in cancer and may be modulated by host immunogenetics. We evaluated whether CTLA-4 and IL-4 variants are associated with qualitative viral DNA detection, focusing on EBV, in a multi-cancer case–control cohort.Methods90 cancer patients and 90 age-/sex-matched controls were enrolled from Southern Iraq.

pmc-13385241.title: The role of the ‘obligation to help others’ within the superwoman schema: implications for physical activity in African American women with low activity levels
pmc-13385241.creator: Allison M Sweeney, Lisa Brockington, Timothy Simmons, Dawn K Wilson, Pamela Martin, Nicole Zarrett
pmc-13385241.description: The Superwoman Schema (SWS) provides a critical framework for understanding how African American (AA) women respond to stress resulting from adversity. While past studies have found that components of the SWS are associated with negative mental health outcomes, little research has evaluated physical activity (PA) and has been limited by self-reports.

pmc-13678440.title: Synthesis of halide perovskite thin films from an eutectic mixture of Pb(NO3)2, acetamide, and urea for fabricating resistive random-access memory (RRAM)
pmc-13678440.creator: Chuong Thanh Huynh, Vy Thao Ha Cao, Tai Duy Nguyen, Tung Thanh Ngo, Em Hoang Danh, Quan Phu Pham, Ngoc Kim Pham, Phuong Tuyet Nguyen
pmc-13678440.description: Methylammonium lead iodide (MAPbI3) perovskite is conventionally synthesized in toxic solvents such as dimethylformamide and dimethyl sulfoxide, whose associated health and environmental risks limit large-scale and sustainable production. Building on our previous work, we further developed a synthesis route for MAPbI3 perovskite using a deep eutectic mixture composed of lead nitrate, acetamide, and urea.

pmc-13700343.title: Methodological considerations in comparing left bundle branch pacing and right ventricular pacing for atrial fibrillation outcomes
pmc-13700343.creator: Muhammad Fayyaz Riaz, Suhail Ahmed, Hayat Asghar
pmc-13700343.description: ve 2-center study addressing an important clinical question. As physiologic pacing strategies continue to gain attention, their findings provide valuable evidence supporting the potential role of LBBP in reducing AF burden among patients requiring ventricular pacing. The authors rightly acknowledge the non-randomized design as a limitation, but several methodological points deserve additional attention.
